title: Geodesic: a parallel test-particle geodesic tracker for the Einstein Toolkit
description: Geodesic is an Einstein Toolkit thorn that integrates timelike test-particle geodesics through the spacetime carried on the Cactus grid. It samples the metric from the grid, integrates with GSL Runge-Kutta, and re-imposes g(u,u) = -1 after each step. It supports Carpet, CarpetRegrid2 AMR, MultiPatch grids, MPI + OpenMP, checkpoint restart, and basic CPU-only CarpetX support. Multi-rank behaviour with the grid samplers is validated at 1, 2 and 4 MPI ranks. The repository contains the thorn source, documentation, the parameter files of the published runs, and the companion paper sources. New-thorn proposal: https://github.com/EinsteinToolkit/tickets/issues/2986
